= Builtin Functions
:page-topic-type: reference
:page-toclevels: 2
:table-caption!:
:description: This section introduces the builtin {sqlppea} functions.

[abstract]
{description}

For reference, a categorized list of all of the builtin functions follows. 
Use the category linked at the end of each list for descriptions and examples of those functions.

Some of the examples in this section assume that you're using a database called `sampleAnalytics` and a scope called `Commerce`.
See xref:intro:connecting-to-data-sources.adoc#install-the-commerce-dataset-in-standalone-collections[] to install the Commerce dataset.
